g.text: THE RECOMMENDATION
Two release paths turn the conference
into practical decisions
Fidelity: expand the complete task
Start with grounded definitions, data navigation
and question-scoped semantic context.
Then add explicit conversation state and bounded
investigation for complex questions.
Pilot one rep-reviewed meeting-preparation
journey in the Salesforce workflow.
Personal agent: strengthen completion
Close count and forecast correctness boundaries;
bind narrative numbers to saved evidence.
Preserve metric identity and grain through
transformation, refresh and report generation.
Use numerical outcome oracles, then complete
one workspace-to-checked-result journey.
The same release test applies to both tracks:
accepted work + total human effort + full known cost + consequential failure modes.
Recommendations based on the application roadmap; proposed local designs, not demonstrated gains.
